hero.tagline: Doi tac tin cay trong ky nguyen so
hero.subtitle: Chuyen cung cap giai phap CNTT va an toan thong tin toan dien, giup doanh nghiep phat trien ben vung va an toan trong moi truong so hoa.

about.heading: Ve SysT
about.intro: Voi hon 5 nam kinh nghiem, SysT la doi tac tin cay cua rat nhieu doanh nghiep trong viec xay dung va bao ve ha tang cong nghe thong tin.

highlights.experienceDesc: Doi ngu chuyen gia voi hon 10 nam kinh nghiem trong linh vuc CNTT va an toan thong tin.
highlights.solutionsDesc: Tu tu van, thiet ke den trien khai va bao tri, chung toi cung cap dich vu end-to-end.
highlights.supportDesc: Doi ngu ky thuat san sang ho tro khach hang 24/7 voi thoi gian phan hoi nhanh chong.
highlights.certificationsDesc: Cac chung nhan ISO 27001, CISSP va nhieu chung nhan quoc te khac.
